buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components): - Supply of Goods as per Monitoring Instruction and drawing . 2) Bidder shall agree to supply material as per Monitoring Instruction. Bidder should submit Monitoring Instructions and drawi ng duly signed & stamped along with their offer for acceptance, failing which offer may be rejected. 3) Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): This Policy is meant for procurement of only goods produ ced (Manufacturer) by MSEs. Traders/ distributors/ sole agent/ Works Contract are excluded from the purview of the policy. 4) Commercial Experience Eligibility Criteria: The bidder should be registered and established for the supply of relevant category of Roll bearing/cylindrical bearing in Ordn ance Factory Ambarnath or other ordnance Factories. (OR) The bidder should be supplier of relevant category (Roll bearing/cylindrical bearing) in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath / Sister Ord nance Factories / State Govt. Departments / Central Govt. / PSU / Public Listed firms / Reputed Private firms during the last 07 years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the last date of bid submission falls and s ubmitted supply order copy as follows: I. Three orders each for supply of relevant category (Roll bearing/cylindrical bearing) where executed value is not less than th e amount of ₹ 1,77,000.00 . (OR) II. Two orders each for supply of relevant category (Roll bearing/cylindrical bearing) where executed value is not less than the amount ₹2,36,000.00/- (OR) III. One order for supply of relevant category (Roll bearing/cylindrical bearing) where executed value is not less than the amo unt of ₹4,13,000.00/- Bidder shall submit relevant Supply Order copy / acceptance certificate or CRAC certificate against executed supply order to me et experience. 5) Turnover - The bidder should have average annual turnover of ₹4 lakh during last 03 financial years. Bidders have to subm it turnover details for the financial year 2023-24, 2024-2025 and 2025-26.

The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st march of the previous financial year, as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certificate audited balance sheets of rele vant periods or a certificate from the charted accountant / cost accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant perio d shall be uploaded with the bid. In case of the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the aver age turnover in respect of the completed financial year after the date of constitution shall be taken into the account for these cr iteria. 6) Payment Terms - 100% Payment on delivery and acceptance of material at factory premises, which can be accepted. In suc h cases, payment is to be made within 30 days of receipt and acceptance of materials at the factory premises along with requisite/relevant documents from suppliers. 7) NOTE - Supply orders where the GST amount shall exceed ₹5,000/-, the invoices should be uploaded immediately by the supplier in his GSTR-1 / IFF so that the invoice appears in GSTR-2B of the branches. if not found in GSTR-2B of the branches, pay ment should be withheld unless it so appears in the GSTR-2B of the branches. 8) All successful bidders must ensure that every service rendered or product supplied under the contract is supported by a ma ndatory e-invoice as per prevailing GST regulations. JCC for the services and IGP for the products are contingent upon the verifi cation of said e-invoice. The purchaser reserves the right to refuse any services lacking proper e-invoice documentation at the supplier’s risk and cost. 9. Bidders have to submit ₹ 41772 as EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) amount. The EMD is normally valid for a period of forty-five days beyond the final bid validity period. EMD shall be obtained in favour of the Yantra India Limited. Ordnance Factory Ambarn ath. The EMD will be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker’s Cheque or Bank Gu arantee from any of the Commercial Banks or payment online in an acceptable form. The validity of EMD will be for a period of Forty-Five days beyond the final bid validity period. Bank Details: Yantra India Ltd. Ordnance Factory Ambarnath A/c No.: 40444 755607 IFSC Code: SBIN0001040 Bank Name: State Bank of India, Ambarnath – 421501 EMD is to submitted from the bidders ex cept Micro and small Enterprises (MSEs) having UDYAM registratio n certificate as defined in MSE procurement policy issued by Department of Micro, small and Medium Enter prises(MSME) or are registered with central purchase organization or the concerned ministry of departmen t including Ordnance Factories or startups as recognized by department of industrial policy an d promotion (DIPP) irrespective of the store for which they are registered.
